description: Replace the Grok auth-broker federation with REAL self-hosted Better Auth that works on built-helion.vercel.app with no external broker and no credentials the user cannot obtain: email+password persisted to the app's own DB (PGLite locally / Neon in prod), plus Google OAuth that activates only when the owner supplies GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET. Auth is OPTIONAL and NON-BLOCKING: the sim and feedback stay fully usable while logged out. Provide sign-up / sign-in / sign-out UI and a visible 'signed in as…' state. Structure providers so more (GitHub, Apple) can be added later with minimal change. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: ACTIVATE THE AUTH SCHEMA (respect the invariant): copy migrations/auth/0001_auth.sql to migrations/0001_auth.sql BYTE-IDENTICALLY (e.g. `cp migrations/auth/0001_auth.sql migrations/0001_auth.sql`). Do NOT hand-edit the copy — scripts/migration-plan.test.mjs asserts the top-level copy is byte-identical to the source AND that the auth schema is not otherwise in the top-level glob (the copy is the sanctioned opt-in). This creates the Better Auth user/session/account/verification tables on both PGLite (auto at startup) and Neon (scripts/migrate.mjs at build).
ENABLE EMAIL/PASSWORD: in src/lib/auth/email-password.ts set `emailAndPasswordEnabled = true`.

REPLACE THE BROKER CONFIG in src/lib/auth/server.ts (the file header says 'do not rewrite' but the whole task is to replace broker federation — rewrite it deliberately and keep the good parts). Requirements: (a) Remove the genericOAuth broker plugin and all reliance on GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_ID/GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET/GROK_AUTH_ISSUER and on src/lib/auth/preview.ts (PREVIEW_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/GROK_ISSUER_DEFAULT). Nothing may require GROK_AUTH_* to function. (b) Keep: the Better Auth instance, the PGLite-vs-Neon `database` selection (Pool when DATABASE_URL else pgliteDialect(() => getPglite())), the __Host- cookie/advanced config, session cookieCache, tanstackStartCookies() last, and bearer() (harmless; keep for parity). (c) Enable `emailAndPassword: { enabled: true }` (guarded by emailAndPasswordEnabled which is now true). (d) Add Google via Better Auth's native social provider: `socialProviders: googleConfigured ? { google: { clientId: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, clientSecret: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET } } : {}` where googleConfigured = Boolean(both env vars trimmed). Absence of Google creds must NOT break email/password or the app. (e) baseURL: use env('BETTER_AUTH_URL') when set (prod, e.g. https://built-helion.vercel.app), else a local-dev default of `http://localhost:3000` (dev serves :3000 — confirm the actual dev origin and make trustedOrigins cover it; include localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] on :3000). (f) secret: env('BETTER_AUTH_SECRET') ?? a process-stable generated dev secret (reuse the existing globalThis-cached previewAuthSecret() pattern so HMR does not invalidate PGLite sessions locally). (g) Keep gateIdentitySessions() plugin only if it stays a harmless no-op when GROK_PROJECT_ID is unset (it is gated on that); if leaving it in complicates the rewrite, it may be dropped as long as gate-identity.test.ts (a pure unit test of gate-identity.server.ts) still passes untouched.

EXPORT `authConfigured` semantics that mean 'real auth is available' WITHOUT GROK_AUTH_*: it must be true whenever auth is enabled (email/password on, or Google configured). verify.server.ts imports authConfigured and uses it to decide whether to resolve a session vs. return the dev user. After this change, getSessionUser must resolve the real Better Auth session (email/password users included) on both local PGLite and prod Neon. Do NOT force auth: requireUserId still throws UnauthorizedError when signed out on protected per-user server fns, but the sim/feedback must never call requireUserId.

REPLACE providers.ts: change GROK_PROVIDERS (broker idp list) into a client-safe list of the SOCIAL providers actually offered (currently just Google), each with id ('google'), label ('Google'), and enough shape that adding {id:'github',label:'GitHub'} later is a one-line change. Keep it dependency-free so the client can import it. Update any imports (server.ts, client.ts).

REWRITE client.ts sign-in surface: keep authClient (createAuthClient from better-auth/react). Add: `signInEmail(email, password)` -> authClient.signIn.email, `signUpEmail({email,password,name})` -> authClient.signUp.email, and `signInSocial(provider)` -> authClient.signIn.social({ provider, callbackURL }). Keep the existing `signOut()` sequencing helper (it clears local state then redirects) — it is fine for cookie-based auth; the popup/bearer/live-preview branches can be simplified or removed since there is no broker popup anymore, but signOut() must still call authClient.signOut() and redirect. Remove genericOAuthClient() plugin usage tied to the broker (the email/password + social client APIs are built-in). Keep `authEnabled` (VITE_AUTH_ENABLED !== 'false').

BUILD AUTH UI (non-blocking, logged-out is first-class): create a sign-in/sign-up surface. Preferred: a new file-based route src/routes/login.tsx (SIGN_IN_PATH in gates.tsx is already '/login') rendering a react-hook-form + zod form with email/password sign-in AND sign-up (toggle), plus a 'Continue with Google' button that is shown only when Google is available (you can gate its visibility on a small server fn or simply always render it and let Better Auth error if unconfigured — prefer a server fn `authProvidersFn` that returns which providers are enabled, so the button hides when Google creds are absent). Use existing ui primitives (Button, inputs styled like feedback-dialog fieldClass) and sonner toasts for success/error. On success redirect to '/'.

SURFACE AUTH STATE IN THE SIM: in src/components/lab/hud.tsx add a compact account control on the right side of the HUD: when signed in show <UserButton /> (from gates.tsx — 'signed in as…' + Sign out); when signed out show a small 'Sign in' link/button navigating to /login. Use useCurrentUserState() and gate on isPending to avoid a signed-out flash. This must NOT block or overlay the sim — it is an optional affordance.

ENSURE NON-BLOCKING: do not add any route guard, redirect, or middleware that forces login for '/' (the sim) or the feedback submit/list/vote paths. The only place requireUserId/authMiddleware may be used is genuinely per-user data (e.g. the settings server-side preference in FEAT-003) — and even there, logged-out must degrade gracefully (client/local persistence), never error the page.

DOCS + ENV: rewrite the Authentication sections of README.md and .env.example to describe REAL self-hosted auth. Required in Vercel: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (openssl rand -hex 32) and BETTER_AUTH_URL (=https://built-helion.vercel.app) and DATABASE_URL (Neon, for persistence). Optional: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET (obtained by the owner in Google Cloud Console; document that the authorized redirect URI is https://built-helion.vercel.app/api/auth/callback/google — verify the exact Better Auth google callback path and document the real one). State clearly that email/password works with zero extra config locally and needs only BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/BETTER_AUTH_URL/DATABASE_URL in prod, and that Google is optional and its absence does not break anything. Remove/replace the GROK_AUTH_*/VITE_AUTH_ENABLED-broker guidance that no longer applies. Do NOT invent real credential values.

TESTS: add a src-level test file (e.g. src/lib/auth/auth-config.test.ts) run under node --experimental-strip-types, and ADD IT to the `test` script's explicit file list in package.json. Test the pure/wireable logic without a live browser: e.g. googleConfigured detection from env (present vs absent), the providers list shape, and that email/password is enabled. If practical, exercise a real Better Auth email sign-up+session against PGLite using the same loader-hook approach as feedback.test.ts (reuse/point at src/lib/feedback/pglite-glob-loader.mjs so migrations including the auth schema are inlined) — insert a real user via authClient/auth.api, no stubs. Keep gate-identity.test.ts passing unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: `cp`-style byte-identical migrations/0001_auth.sql exists and `node --test scripts/migration-plan.test.mjs` passes (auth-schema-location + byte-identical-copy invariants hold).

No source module references GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_ID/GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET/GROK_AUTH_ISSUER or imports PREVIEW_CLIENT_ID/PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET for auth to function (grep confirms broker creds are no longer required).
emailAndPasswordEnabled === true and server.ts enables emailAndPassword and conditionally enables Google only when both GOOGLE_CLIENT_* are set.

Running `npm run dev` (http://localhost:3000) allows: sign up with email+password, sign out, sign back in — persisted in local PGLite; the HUD shows a 'signed in as…' state after sign-in and a 'Sign in' affordance when logged out.
The sim ('/') and feedback submit/list/vote work with NO login (no forced redirect, no error) — logged-out is fully functional.
Google button is hidden (or clearly inert) when GOOGLE_CLIENT_* are unset; its absence does not break email/password or the app.

README.md and .env.example document exactly which Vercel env vars are required (BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_URL, DATABASE_URL) vs optional (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) with no invented secret values.
New auth test file passes and is wired into `npm test`; gate-identity.test.ts still passes; no NEW typecheck errors beyond the pre-existing set from FEAT-001.
verification: npm run dev then manually: sign up / sign out / sign in with email+password against local PGLite; confirm sim + feedback work logged out

findings.summary: Replaced the Grok auth-broker federation with REAL self-hosted Better Auth (email/password + optional Google). Auth is optional and non-blocking; sim + feedback untouched and never gated. Baseline preserved: build exits 0, 28 tsc errors unchanged, npm test still 179 pass / 16 pre-existing scripts failures. Src-level suite grew 46 -> 59 (added 13 auth tests).
findings.migration_activation: Copied migrations/auth/0001_auth.sql -> migrations/0001_auth.sql byte-identically (verified a.equals(b)=true). This makes the Better Auth user/session/account/verification tables apply on PGLite (startup) and Neon (build).
findings.migration_plan_test_change: scripts/migration-plan.test.mjs test 'the auth schema ships outside the globbed directory' was CHANGED. In PR #2 it was relaxed to forbid ANY top-level 0001_auth.sql, which directly contradicts the sanctioned byte-identical copy this task requires (it failed after the copy). Updated it to allow a top-level 0001_auth.sql ONLY when it is byte-identical to migrations/auth/0001_auth.sql (the sanctioned sign-in opt-in), while still forbidding an edited/stray copy. All 7 migration-plan tests pass.
findings.server_ts: Rewrote src/lib/auth/server.ts: removed genericOAuth broker plugin, GROK_AUTH_* env usage, and all preview.ts imports. Kept betterAuth instance, PGLite-vs-Neon database selection, __Host- cookie/advanced config, session cookieCache, bearer(), tanstackStartCookies() last, and the dormant gateIdentitySessions() (no-op unless GROK_PROJECT_ID). Added emailAndPassword:{enabled:true} (guarded by emailAndPasswordEnabled=true) and socialProviders (google only when both GOOGLE_CLIENT_* set). baseURL = BETTER_AUTH_URL ?? http://localhost:3000; trustedOrigins cover the prod origin + localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] on :3000 (dev serves :3000 per package.json). secret = BETTER_AUTH_SECRET ?? globalThis-cached previewAuthSecret(). Changed the `../db` import to `@/lib/db` for consistency (Vite resolves both).
findings.config_split: Extracted pure detection (isGoogleConfigured, isAuthDisabled, isAuthConfigured, readEnv) into a NEW dependency-free src/lib/auth/config.ts so both server.ts and the unit test can use it without loading the server-only Better Auth instance / pglite-dialect (whose constructor parameter-property syntax node --experimental-strip-types cannot parse). server.ts's googleConfigured/authConfigured now delegate to these. authConfigured means 'real auth available' = not force-disabled AND (email/password on OR Google configured) — no GROK_AUTH_* required. verify.server.ts needed no change (it re-exports/branches on authConfigured).
findings.providers: Replaced GROK_PROVIDERS broker list with client-safe SOCIAL_PROVIDERS = [{id:'google',label:'Google'}], shaped so {id:'github',label:'GitHub'} is a one-line add.
findings.client_ts: Rewrote src/lib/auth/client.ts: authClient=createAuthClient() (no genericOAuthClient, no bearer machinery). Added signInEmail, signUpEmail({email,password,name}), signInSocial(provider,callbackURL). Kept authEnabled and the runSignOut()-based signOut() sequencing (cookie path). getBearerToken() kept as a null-returning shim because middleware.ts imports it.
findings.popup_server: src/lib/auth/popup.server.ts reduced to an inert 410 stub (real auth uses full-page redirect, no popup); the dev-only vite authPopupPlugin still loads it but nothing opens /auth/popup.
findings.preview_ts_removed: Deleted src/lib/auth/preview.ts (baked broker preview client + hardcoded secret) — fully orphaned after the rewrite.
findings.ui: Added src/routes/login.tsx (react-hook-form + zod, email/password sign-in AND sign-up toggle, Google button rendered only when authProvidersFn reports it; sonner toasts; redirects to '/'; offers 'Continue without signing in'). Added AccountControl to src/components/lab/hud.tsx: <UserButton/> when signed in, a compact 'Sign in' link to /login when signed out, gated on isPending to avoid flash; never blocks/overlays the sim. Added src/lib/auth/functions.ts with authProvidersFn (server fn returning {emailAndPassword, social[]} so the client hides Google when creds absent).
findings.non_blocking: No route guard/redirect/middleware forces login for '/' or feedback. submitFeedbackFn etc. remain unauthed. Confirmed no new authMiddleware/requireUserId usage was added to sim/feedback paths.
findings.tests: Added src/lib/auth/auth-config.test.ts (13 tests: SOCIAL_PROVIDERS shape, emailAndPasswordEnabled===true, isGoogleConfigured present/absent/one-only/whitespace/no-broker-effect, isAuthConfigured email-only/google-only/force-disabled/nothing/no-GROK_AUTH). Wired into package.json test script's explicit file list. gate-identity.test.ts unchanged and passing.
findings.runtime_verification: Since the dev-server launcher is blocked in this sandbox, ran a REAL runtime smoke via a temporary vite SSR bundle of the actual auth/server.ts against embedded PGLite (then deleted the temp files): authConfigured=true/googleConfigured=false; email/password SIGN-UP -> 200 + real session cookie; getSession resolved the persisted user by email; SIGN-IN with same creds -> 200; WRONG password rejected ('Invalid password'). With GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET set, googleConfigured flipped to true. Origin http://localhost:3000 was accepted (no 'Invalid origin'), confirming trustedOrigins matches the dev port. This is genuine persistence on PGLite via the copied auth migration — no stubs.
findings.docs: Rewrote the Authentication sections of README.md and .env.example for real self-hosted auth: REQUIRED in Vercel = BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (openssl rand -hex 32), BETTER_AUTH_URL (=https://built-helion.vercel.app), DATABASE_URL (Neon); OPTIONAL = GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET with the exact Google redirect URI https://built-helion.vercel.app/api/auth/callback/google. Removed GROK_AUTH_*/broker guidance and updated the admin section (which had claimed no working sign-in). No invented secret values.

verification_results.src_suite: node --experimental-strip-types --test app-data + auth-config + gate-identity + feedback -> 59 pass / 0 fail
verification_results.npm_test: 179 pass / 16 fail (same pre-existing environmental scripts failures; migration-plan NOT among them)
verification_results.tsc: npx tsc --noEmit -> 28 errors, identical to the FEAT-001 baseline set (engine.ts 6, audio.ts 1, emitters.test.ts 5, physics.ts 7, webgpu-backend.ts 2, pglite-glob-loader.mjs 7); zero new errors after the vite build regenerated routeTree.gen.ts with /login
verification_results.build: npm run build -> exit 0 (vite build + db:migrate skip + sync-dist)
verification_results.grep_broker: grep for GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/ISSUER + PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET in src/ -> only negative-assertion cases in auth-config.test.ts; no functional dependency

findings.notes_for_later_features: routeTree.gen.ts is generated and now includes /login (committed). config.ts is the pure home for auth-availability checks. FEAT-003 (settings 'auto-fill email' toggle defaulting OFF) is the remaining user requirement: per the non-blocking rule, if it uses a per-user server preference behind authMiddleware, logged-out must degrade to local persistence and never error the page. The user explicitly wants auto-fill OFF by default, only pre-filling when ON + logged in.
